notes.zh-CN: 对话导航条靠到内容区左侧，和 Codex 一样待在外侧留白里；把鼠标移到刻度上会弹出进度卡片，显示第几条 / 共几条和那条消息的开头，点一下就跳过去。输入区那排控件换行时，模型 / 推理 / 发送这一组固定贴右，不再掉到第二行左边、把发送按钮夹在中间。
notes.en: The conversation rail now sits against the left edge of the content area, out in the margin the way Codex keeps its outline; hovering a tick opens a card with its position (n of m) and the start of that message, and clicking still jumps there. In the composer, when the control row wraps, the model / effort / send group stays pinned to the right edge instead of dropping to a new row with the send button stranded mid-row.
